citations.claim: W approach red with queue 200 and wait 201 at first violating step, NS green stuck
W already waiting 153s at red with queue 197 while NS green held during S detector_fail
W waiting 113s at red with queue 190 while NS green held during S detector_fail

counterfactual.change: Removed the single detector_fail event on S (t2144 duration 203); all else identical. This removes the failure and no rule is violated, showing the failed detector pins NS green.

explanation: NS green starts around step ~2090 after EW green at 2080. Detector_fail on S starts at t2144 (duration 203) in the middle of that NS green. While the failure is active the NS green is never terminated despite max_green_seconds=73 and growing conflicting demand on W (W wait 57 at 2144, 113 at 2200, 153 at 2240, 201 at 2288 with ~190-200 queued). The controller appears to treat the failed S detector as presence/extend demand (or to suspend max-out/recall while a detector in the green direction is failed), so the actuated green is extended indefinitely and the long-wait recall for W never fires, starving W past the 200s max_wait limit.

violation.detail: approach 3 has waited 201 s at red with vehicles queued (limit 200)

vision_note: The north-south approaches stay green while a long queue of vehicles waits at red on the west approach. From step 2285 to 2288 the signals never change and the queued traffic never discharges.
